title: AMFI Systematic Facilities: SIP, Systematic Transfer Plan (STP), and SWP
source: Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI)
content: AMFI outlines 3 primary systematic facility modes in mutual funds: 1. Systematic Investment Plan (SIP): Periodic fixed contributions into a target scheme leveraging rupee cost averaging. 2. Systematic Transfer Plan (STP): Automated periodic transfer of fixed amounts from a liquid/debt fund to an equity scheme. 3. Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP): Automated periodic redemption of a fixed amount from a fund to provide cash flow during retirement.
